text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking through a field,
when...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pandorea ☆ pandorana!
Paphiopedilum ☆
insigne!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
O sparrow! I bless you with the power of
Mother
Nature. Rise, and become a
phoenix! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear Sweep Tosho chanting some kind
of spell...
but nothing in particular
happens after she
finishes.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you interested in my magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Then I'll let you watch. I'm in
the middle
of some transformation
practi—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The sparrow I was practicing on!
It's
gone...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... It took me an entire hour to find
it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A cool spell? Ooh, what's the
incantation?!
choice_data_list: 代わりにすごい呪文を教えよう
もう1度スズメを探しに行こう
choice_data_list_en: I'll teach you an amazing spell instead.
Let's go look for the sparrow again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spout off random terms that sound
impressive
enough—specifically, the
names of the special
symbols websites
require you to include in
passwords.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Semicolon! Apostrophe! Circumflex
accent!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds super powerful...
What does it
do?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I'm gonna go try it out on
someone in the
hallway!
choice_data_list_en: I think... you can get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho leaves, glowing with high
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it! Once we find it, I can
show you
my transformation spell!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah, there it is! Okay...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Protea ☆ longifolia! Paphiopedilum ☆
callosum!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
O sparrow! I bless you with the power of
Mother
Nature. Rise, and become a
phoenix! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, nothing happens.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! Whyyy?! Why didn't it
work?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho continues recasting her
spell until
the day grows old and the sun
goes down... but
the sparrow
unfortunately remains a sparrow.
